issue.title: 4 test_usage_config tests assert a bundled weekly:claude-fable-5 window that c00964773 removed from default_config.yml
issue.description:
Four tests in `tests/llm_provider/test_usage_config.py` still assert a bundled
`weekly:claude-fable-5` usage-indicator window that commit c00964773
("feat(llm-provider): govern Claude Fable usage indicator by generic threshold",
SASE_BEAD=sase-14c.3, epic sase-14c, now CLOSED) removed from
`src/sase/default_config.yml`. That key now exists only as commented-out example YAML
(default_config.yml:1571-1575), so the bundled default no longer has a `claude`
provider entry at all.

Failing nodes (all at master 383f2c282):

- `tests/llm_provider/test_usage_config.py::test_usage_indicator_defaults_and_overrides`
  -> `KeyError: 'claude'` at
  `settings.config["providers"]["claude"]["windows"]["weekly:claude-fable-5"]`
  (test_usage_config.py:213)
- `tests/llm_provider/test_usage_config.py::test_usage_indicator_real_bundled_default_and_user_override_projection[empty-provider-map-keeps-bundled-exact-window]`
- `...[unrelated-provider-override-keeps-claude-defaults]`
- `...[broader-provider-default-loses-to-exact-window]`
  -> all three assert the projected window keys still contain `weekly:claude-fable-5`,
  e.g. `assert ('weekly', 'session-low') == ('weekly', 'session-low', 'weekly:claude-fable-5')`
  (test_usage_config.py:329)

Remediation: decide which side is authoritative. Either the generic-threshold policy
c00964773 landed is correct and these four tests must be rewritten to assert the new
bundled shape (no `claude` provider entry, two projected windows), or the bundled
default lost an entry it should have kept and `src/sase/default_config.yml` needs the
`weekly:claude-fable-5` window restored. The epic that made the change is closed, so
this is not the epic's own remaining work.

Found while landing epic sase-14l (unrelated: notification settlement dismissal). Not
caused by sase-14l, which touches only
`src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_notification_*` and `_unread_state.py`.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic on every run: reproduced in the full just check lane (44321 tests, 6 workers) and again in an isolated serial rerun with -p no:randomly at the same SHA. The assertion reads a committed YAML file, so there is no timing, ordering, or concurrency input. The removed key is visibly commented out at src/sase/default_config.yml:1571-1575 by c00964773, which is the direct cause.

payload.entry: Fixed: same usage-indicator updates as sase-14u (duplicate). Verified in sase tool run check f22c65d1f9cb614b29992f26341a7f86.
